texts.facts: The petitioner has filed the petition under Section 12 of Protection of Woman from Domestic Violence Act, 2005 against the respondents for seeking various relief under the Act. Subsequently, the respondents began harassing the petitioner both physically and mentally, primarily in relation to their demand for a dowry of Rs. 5,00,000/-, a car, and a site. She also prevented the petitioner from eating and restricted her ability to communicate freely with her husband. Moreover, the second respondent interfered in all matters between the petitioner and the first respondent. The petitioner was forced to seek treatment at Government Hospital, Mandya. She produced documents marked as Exhibits P.1 to P.6 and subsequently closed her side of the case. Despite granting sufficient time, the respondents did not cross-examined the PW.1.
